title.zh: OpenAI Fires Three Safety Researchers Over Alleged Leak to Outside Group
title.en: OpenAI Fires Three Safety Researchers Over Alleged Leak to Outside Group

current_state.zh: OpenAI confirmed it parted ways with three safety researchers for allegedly sharing confidential company information with an outside AI safety organization, amid a broader wave of departures and unconfirmed speculation about who was involved.
